exercises.title: BST insert (no duplicates) and search — iteratively
concepts: shape depends on the insertion order
exercises.problemHtml:
BST has Node root. Complete with loops (the grader builds trees of a million random keys):

  • boolean insert(int key) — walk down from the root (smaller → left, larger → right) and attach a new leaf; a key already present is not inserted (return false);
  • boolean contains(int key);
  • int size() — keep a counter.

After each command the grader prints the SHAPE of your tree from the real left/right links (8(3(1,6),10)) — so a key attached at the wrong place shows even if contains() works.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 1,000,000 random keys, then 1,000,000 searches) inside a 4-second limit. An O(log n) per operation on random input solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n) per operation (scanning all keys) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Iterative insert and contains.
  • Node is given.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
BST có Node root. Hoàn thiện bằng vòng lặp (máy chấm dựng cây một triệu khoá ngẫu nhiên): insert(key) — đi từ gốc xuống (nhỏ hơn → trái, lớn hơn → phải) rồi gắn một lá mới; khoá đã có thì không chèn (trả false); contains(key); size() — giữ một bộ đếm.

Sau mỗi lệnh máy chấm in HÌNH cây từ các liên kết left/right thật (8(3(1,6),10)) — khoá gắn sai chỗ sẽ lộ ra dù contains() vẫn chạy.

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 1,000,000 random keys, then 1,000,000 searches) trong hạn 4 giây. Lời giải O(log n) per operation on random input xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(n) per operation (scanning all keys) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

  • insert và contains bằng vòng lặp.
  • Node cho sẵn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Insert and search follow one root-to-leaf path: O(h). For random insertion orders the expected height is about 2.99·log₂ n (≈ 50–60 for a million keys), so both are fast; sorted insertions degrade the tree into a chain (h = n) — the motivation for AVL trees in 4.6.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Chèn và tìm đi theo một đường gốc–lá: O(h). Với thứ tự chèn ngẫu nhiên, chiều cao kỳ vọng khoảng 2,99·log₂ n (≈ 50–60 với một triệu khoá), nên cả hai đều nhanh; chèn theo thứ tự tăng làm cây suy biến thành chuỗi (h = n) — lý do có cây AVL ở bài 4.6.

mistakesJson.loi: Walking until p == null and then "p = new Node(key)" — the new node is assigned to a local variable, never linked to its parent.|||Đi tới khi p == null rồi "p = new Node(key)" — nút mới chỉ gán vào biến cục bộ, không bao giờ được nối vào cha.
Incrementing size even when the key was a duplicate.|||Tăng size cả khi khoá bị trùng.

exercises.title: Floor, ceiling and counting keys in a range — with pruning
exercises.problemHtml:
On the given BST (insert is given), complete:

  • Integer floor(int x) and Integer ceiling(int x) — null if none; one root-to-leaf walk each;
  • int countRange(int lo, int hi) — keys with lo ≤ key ≤ hi. Recurse only where keys in the range can be: if t.key < lo the left subtree holds nothing useful; if t.key > hi the right subtree does not either;
  • String range(int lo, int hi) — those keys in increasing order, separated by spaces.

The complexity check asks 200,000 narrow range counts on a tree of a million keys: a full traversal per query is far too slow.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 1,000,000 keys, 200,000 range queries) inside a 4-second limit. An O(h + k) per query solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n) per query (visiting every node) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • floor/ceiling O(h); countRange O(h + number of keys in the range).
  • Do not traverse the whole tree.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Pruning makes the range query visit only the two boundary paths plus the k nodes inside the range: O(h + k). With h ≈ 50 and k ≈ 10 per query, 200,000 queries need a few hundred million steps at most, while full traversals would need 2·10¹¹. java.util.TreeMap offers the same operations (floorKey, ceilingKey, subMap).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Tỉa nhánh làm truy vấn khoảng chỉ ghé hai đường biên cộng k nút trong khoảng: O(h + k). Với h ≈ 50 và k ≈ 10 mỗi truy vấn, 200.000 truy vấn tốn vài trăm triệu bước là cùng, còn duyệt cả cây cần 2·10¹¹. java.util.TreeMap có sẵn các thao tác này (floorKey, ceilingKey, subMap).

mistakesJson.loi: Collecting the whole inorder and filtering — correct but O(n) per query.|||Gom cả trung thứ tự rồi lọc — đúng nhưng O(n) mỗi truy vấn.
Returning int with -1 for "no floor" — -1 can be a real key; that is why the result is Integer/null.|||Trả int với -1 cho "không có floor" — -1 có thể là khoá thật; vì vậy kết quả là Integer/null.

exercises.title: Is this binary tree a BST? Check every node against its bounds
concepts: the BST property is global, not parent-child
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static boolean isBST(Node t): true when every key in the left subtree of every node is smaller than the node’s key and every key in its right subtree is larger (no duplicates). Checking only each node against its two children is not enough: in 8(3(1,9),10) every parent–child pair is fine, but 9 is in the left subtree of 8.

Pass the allowed range down: check(t, lo, hi) with long bounds (keys may be Integer.MIN_VALUE or MAX_VALUE).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • O(n), one traversal.
  • Empty tree = true.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hoàn thiện static boolean isBST(Node t): true khi mọi khoá ở cây con trái của mọi nút nhỏ hơn khoá của nút đó và mọi khoá ở cây con phải lớn hơn (không trùng). Chỉ kiểm mỗi nút với hai con của nó là không đủ: trong 8(3(1,9),10) mọi cặp cha–con đều ổn, nhưng 9 nằm trong cây con trái của 8.

Truyền khoảng cho phép xuống dưới: check(t, lo, hi) với cận kiểu long (khoá có thể là Integer.MIN_VALUE hay MAX_VALUE).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Each node is checked once against the tightest bounds its ancestors impose: O(n). Equivalent check: an inorder traversal of a BST is strictly increasing.

mistakesJson.loi: Comparing each node only with its children — "8 3 10 1 9" is accepted although 9 > 8 sits on the left.|||Chỉ so mỗi nút với con của nó — "8 3 10 1 9" được chấp nhận dù 9 > 8 nằm bên trái.
Using <= / >= the wrong way round — duplicates slip through.|||Dùng <= / >= ngược chiều — khoá trùng lọt qua.
